title: phleum phleoides subsp. montanum
intro: Phleum phleoides subsp. montanum, commonly known as mountain timothy, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and soothing digestive issues, making it a potential remedy for various health concerns. The therapeutic actions of mountain timothy include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal effects and make it a promising natural remedy.
